reader.zh-Hant:
這組工具讓 Agent 在 materials 目錄內列出、讀取與摘要素材檔。

典型用途：把長篇參考資料放在 materials/，由模型透過工具分段讀取，避免一次塞爆上下文。摘要工具的行為與長度裁切請以實作與提示詞約定為準。

路徑與權限錯誤時，工具多會回傳可讀錯誤字串；除錯時請同時檢查 materials 目錄結構與檔名。
reader.en:
These tools let the agent **list**, **read**, and **summarize** files under a `materials/` directory.

Typical pattern: store long reference documents on disk and let the model pull them in chunks instead of stuffing everything into one prompt. Summarization behavior depends on implementation + prompt contracts.

Errors often surface as readable strings; verify folder layout and filenames when debugging.
reader.ja:
`materials/` 配下のファイルを**列挙・読取・要約**するツール群です。

長文資料をディスクに置き、モデルが段階的に読む用途に向きます。要約の粒度や長さ制限は実装とプロンプトの約束に依存します。

権限やパス問題は文字列エラーになりがちなので、ディレクトリ構成とファイル名も合わせて確認してください。

symbols.name: ListMaterialsTool
symbols.summary: List files under ./materials with relative path, text line count, and human-readable file size.

tool_contract.name: list_materials
tool_contract.description: List all files under ./materials with relative path, line count, and file size.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(save_policy: str = 'inline', output_target: str = 'memory', output_path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs) -> Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]
methods.summary: Scan materials recursively and return list text, with optional file-routing payload.

symbols.name: ReadMaterialTool
symbols.summary: Read a text file inside ./materials by explicit line range and/or keyword-matched paragraphs.

tool_contract.name: read_material
tool_contract.description: Read text content from a file inside ./materials by line range or keywords.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(file_path: str, start_line: Optional[int] = None, end_line: Optional[int] = None, keywords: Optional[List[str]] = None, save_policy: str = 'inline', output_target: str = 'memory', output_path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs) -> Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]
methods.summary: Resolve the target file safely, then return numbered lines/keyword matches. Can route output to file mode.
behavior: Returns an explicit guidance message when neither line range nor keywords are provided.
Keyword matching is paragraph-based and case-insensitive.
Supports file_path with optional materials/ prefix.

symbols.name: SummarizeMaterialTool
symbols.summary: Summarize a supported text file under ./materials, optionally compressing the global summary with Gemini lite.

tool_contract.name: summarize_material
tool_contract.description: Summarize a text file inside ./materials with a lite Gemini model and extract keywords for each paragraph.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(file_path: str, save_policy: str = 'inline', output_target: str = 'memory', output_path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs) -> Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]
methods.summary: Return an overall summary, keywords, and per-paragraph summaries; can route output to file mode.
behavior: Truncates source text to max_summary_chars before summarization.
Attempts Gemini compression first when GEMINI_KEY is configured.
Falls back to heuristic paragraph summarization when Gemini is unavailable or fails.

examples.title: Typical materials inspection flow
code_lines: from src.tools.materials_manager import ListMaterialsTool, ReadMaterialTool, SummarizeMaterialTool

runtime_notes.content: All tools are confined to the resolved ./materials directory. Paths escaping that root are rejected.
read/summarize accept file_path with optional materials/ or .\materials\ style prefix and normalize before resolution.
read_material and summarize_material support save_policy/output_target/output_path and may return structured payload for runtime file routing.
Text operations are limited to the built-in supported extension set such as .txt, .md, .json, .csv, .py, .yaml, .log, .html, and selected code files.
SummarizeMaterialTool uses GEMINI_KEY and GEMINI_MODEL when available to compress the overall summary to 400 Chinese characters or fewer.
